formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the allowance of the spender over the owner's vUSDC vault shares to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).

With this allowance the spender can move the owner's shares with transferFrom, or redeem/withdraw them for the underlying USDC to any receiver (ERC4626Upgradeable._withdraw spends the allowance when caller != owner).
An allowance of type(uint256).max is never reduced when spent (OZ _spendAllowance), so it is unlimited.
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce; the signature works only until `deadline`.
formats.shown: The screen says 'Approve <amount> vUSDC for <spender> until <deadline>' and shows the share owner, spender, allowance amount in vUSDC (or 'Unlimited' at the max value), the signature deadline as a date, and the nonce.

findings.title: Permit: share allowance also lets the spender redeem the signer's shares for USDC to any receiver.
findings.evidence: ERC4626Upgradeable._withdraw: `if (caller != owner) { _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); }`; VaultV2.redeem/withdraw call super with any `receiver`. Descriptor intent: 'Authorize share spending'.
findings.fix: Optional: say it in the intent, e.g. 'Allow spender to move or redeem vault shares'.
